name: Rhea
source:
The heroine. Rhea is a nurse at the local hospital. She is a hard-working young girl, but gets flustered easily. She's often too nice to her patients, and can get caught up talking to them instead of doing her job. She prays at church almost every morning.

(Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/this-world-unknown/]website[/url])
